purpose: 제공된 데이터와 분석 프로세스/산출물의 상태를 과학적 검증과 구분하여 분석한다.

preparation: define question, units, sample/cohort, metadata, data source, expected outputs and QC
for processes identify job, PID/container, logs, resources, outputs and restart boundary
define execution-complete, output-integrity and scientific-PASS gates separately
execution: track missingness, exclusions, transformations and revision
verification: data: sample identity, QC, model assumptions, effect, confidence interval, missing data, multiple testing and generalization limits
process: live process/container/job, log recency, error/OOM/resource scan and output integrity
never infer biological validity from file existence or command success
completion: report findings, evidence, limitations and one next action
record reproducible inputs, methods, versions and artifact paths
